data.season_note_zh: 数据像水一样汇聚、沉淀，是一切的源头
data.season_note_en: Data gathers and settles like water — the source of everything

train.season_note_zh: 模型从数据里生长出来

infer.season_note_zh: 算力如火，模型被大规模地跑起来
infer.season_note_en: Compute burns like fire as models run at scale

agent.zh: 白虎 · 智能体与应用
agent.season_note_zh: 把模型能力收成为用户手里的产品
agent.season_note_en: Model capability is harvested into products people use

dev.zh: 重点看夏长和秋收：写接口、调模型、编排智能体；冬藏里的数据结构和向量检索是 RAG 的必经之路。
dev.en: Focus on Summer (serving) and Autumn (apps): building APIs, calling models and orchestrating agents. In Winter (data), schemas and vector search are unavoidable for RAG.

pm.zh: 重点看秋收和夏长：用户摸得到的应用层，和决定成本、速度与质量数字的推理和观测层。
pm.en: Focus on Autumn (apps) and Summer (inference): the app layer users actually touch, and the inference and observability layers that set cost, speed and the quality numbers.

qa.zh: 重点看各层交界处：输入解析、输出校验、工具调用、页面渲染和线上评测，故障多藏在这里。
qa.en: Focus on the seams between layers: input parsing, output validation, tool calls, page rendering and production evals — that’s where failures hide.

algo.zh: 重点看冬藏到春生：数据处理、深度学习框架和模型仓库，再到夏长的推理优化；应用层了解即可。
algo.en: Focus on Winter (data) through Spring (training): data processing, deep learning frameworks and the model hub, then inference optimization in Summer. The app layer is good-to-know only.

core.zh_desc: 绝大多数服务器、云主机和 GPU 集群运行的操作系统内核。AI 训练与推理几乎都跑在它上面。
core.en_desc: The OS kernel under nearly every server, cloud VM and GPU cluster; almost all AI training and inference runs on it.

core.zh: GCC 与 LLVM 编译器
core.zh_desc: 把 C/C++ 源码编译成机器码的工具链。NumPy、PyTorch 的底层代码都要经过它们编译；LLVM 还是 Triton 等 AI 编译器的基础。
core.en_desc: Toolchains that turn C/C++ into machine code. NumPy and PyTorch internals are compiled by them; LLVM also underpins AI compilers such as Triton.

core.zh_desc: Linux 上几乎所有程序共用的 C 标准库，负责内存、文件、线程等最基础的系统调用封装。
core.en_desc: The C standard library shared by almost every Linux program: memory, files, threads and other basic system-call wrappers.

core.zh_desc: Python 语言的官方实现。图里所有 Python 地基都运行在它之上。
core.en_desc: The reference implementation of Python; every Python foundation on this map runs on it.

core.zh_desc: 让 JavaScript 在浏览器之外运行的运行时，内核是 Chrome 的 V8 引擎。图里所有 npm 地基都依赖它。
core.en_desc: The runtime that runs JavaScript outside the browser, built on Chrome's V8 engine; every npm foundation here depends on it.

core.zh_desc: 互联网加密通信（HTTPS/TLS）的事实标准实现。每一次调用模型 API，都经过它或它的分支加密。
core.en_desc: The de facto TLS/HTTPS implementation. Every call to a model API is encrypted by it or one of its forks.

core.zh_desc: 最常用的网络传输库与命令行工具，装在数十亿台设备上。很多下载器、包管理器和 SDK 底层都靠它。
core.en_desc: The most widely used network transfer library and CLI, installed on billions of devices; many downloaders, package managers and SDKs rely on it.

core.zh_desc: 最通用的数据压缩库。网页、PNG 图片、Git 对象、模型文件打包都在用。
core.en_desc: The most common compression library, used by web traffic, PNG images, Git objects and model packaging.

core.zh_desc: 高压缩率的压缩库，深埋在无数系统底层。2024 年的 xz 后门事件说明：维护者寥寥的“隐形地基”也可能成为整条供应链的突破口。
core.en_desc: A high-ratio compression library buried deep in countless systems. The 2024 xz backdoor showed how a thinly maintained invisible foundation can become a supply-chain weak point.

core.zh_desc: 版本控制系统。GitHub、Hugging Face Hub 上的代码与模型仓库都建立在它之上。
core.en_desc: The version control system under every code and model repository on GitHub and Hugging Face Hub.

core.zh_desc: 部署量最大的数据库引擎，嵌在手机、浏览器和大量 AI 应用里（例如 Chroma 的本地模式）。
core.en_desc: The most widely deployed database engine, embedded in phones, browsers and many AI apps (e.g. Chroma's local mode).

core.zh_desc: 线性代数运算的标准接口与实现（OpenBLAS 等）。NumPy、SciPy 的矩阵乘法最终都落到这里。
core.en_desc: The standard interfaces and implementations (e.g. OpenBLAS) for linear algebra; NumPy and SciPy matrix maths ends up here.

core.zh_desc: 英伟达 GPU 的编程平台。它不是开源项目，但几乎所有 GPU 训练与推理都绕不开它，所以作为特例列入地心并单独标注。
core.en_desc: NVIDIA's GPU programming platform. Not open source, but nearly all GPU training and inference depends on it, so it is listed in the core as a flagged exception.

zh.what: 把“调用模型 → 决定下一步 → 调用工具 → 记住结果”这套循环做成可复用的框架，让开发者用几十行代码搭出能干活的智能体。
zh.before: 每个团队手写提示词拼接、解析模型输出、管理对话历史，换一个模型就要重写一遍。

roles.dev: 先跑通一个带工具调用的最小示例，再看它怎么管理状态和记忆。
roles.pm: 它决定了做一个“会用工具的助手”需要几周还是几个月。
roles.qa: 故障多出在工具调用参数错误、循环不收敛和上下文溢出。
roles.algo: 位于推理链路的最上层：编排多次模型调用，而不训练模型。

en.what: Turns the loop of “call a model → decide the next step → call a tool → remember the result” into reusable frameworks, so a working agent takes dozens of lines instead of a project.
en.before: Every team hand-wrote prompt assembly, output parsing and chat history, and rewrote it whenever the model changed.

roles.dev: Run a minimal tool-calling example first, then study how it manages state and memory.
roles.pm: It decides whether a tool-using assistant takes weeks or months to build.
roles.qa: Failures cluster around bad tool arguments, loops that never converge and context overflow.
roles.algo: Sits at the top of the inference chain: it orchestrates many model calls but trains nothing.

zh.what: 规定模型和外部工具、数据源之间怎么“说话”的标准协议（以 MCP 为代表），一个工具写一次，就能被所有支持协议的客户端调用。
zh.before: 每接一个工具就写一套专用插件，换一个 AI 客户端就要重写。

roles.dev: 照官方 SDK 写一个最小 MCP 服务器，接进一个现成客户端。
roles.pm: 它把“接入一个新系统”从定制开发变成配置，直接影响集成成本。
roles.qa: 重点测权限边界、超时和工具返回格式异常。
roles.algo: 不涉及训练；理解它有助于设计工具调用类评测。

en.what: Standard protocols (MCP is the leading one) for how models talk to external tools and data sources: write a tool once and every compliant client can use it.
en.before: Each tool needed a bespoke plugin, rewritten for every AI client.

roles.dev: Build a minimal MCP server with the official SDK and plug it into an existing client.
roles.pm: It turns integrating a new system from custom work into configuration, which changes integration cost.
roles.qa: Focus on permission boundaries, timeouts and malformed tool results.
roles.algo: No training involved; it helps when designing tool-use evaluations.

zh.what: 让模型“会做事”的一层：智能体框架把“调用模型 → 决定下一步 → 调用工具 → 记住结果”编排成循环，工具协议（以 MCP 为代表）规定模型怎样连接外部工具和数据。
zh.before: 每个团队手写提示词拼接和输出解析，每接一个工具写一套专用插件，换模型或换客户端就要重写。

roles.dev: 先跑通一个带工具调用的最小示例，再看框架怎么管理状态、记忆和工具注册。
roles.pm: 它决定做一个“会用工具的助手”需要几周还是几个月，也决定能接哪些现成工具。
roles.qa: 故障多出在工具参数错误、循环不收敛、上下文溢出和工具权限越界。
roles.algo: 位于推理链路最上层：编排多次模型调用，而不训练模型。

en.what: The layer that lets models get things done: agent frameworks orchestrate the loop of “call a model → decide the next step → call a tool → remember the result”, and tool protocols (led by MCP) define how models connect to outside tools and data.
en.before: Every team hand-wrote prompt assembly and output parsing, built a bespoke plugin per tool, and rewrote it all when the model or client changed.

roles.dev: Run a minimal tool-calling example first, then study how the framework manages state, memory and tool registration.
roles.pm: It decides whether a tool-using assistant takes weeks or months, and which ready-made tools you can plug in.
roles.qa: Failures cluster around bad tool arguments, loops that never converge, context overflow and over-broad tool permissions.
roles.algo: Sits at the top of the inference chain: it orchestrates many model calls but trains nothing.

zh: 第 4 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 5.1，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 13。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
白虎扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 20% · 青龙 4% · 朱雀 7% · 白虎 69%。
大小第 2 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 8。
en: Ring 4: its core members average dependency level 5.1, #13 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
White Tiger sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 20% · Dragon 4% · Bird 7% · Tiger 69%.
Size tier 2: #8 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 调用大模型服务的官方与通用客户端库：统一处理鉴权、流式输出、重试和结构化输出，让应用用几行代码接上 GPT、Claude、Gemini 或本地模型。
zh.before: 直接拼 HTTP 请求、自己解析流式数据，每家模型的接口格式都不一样。

roles.dev: 先用一个 SDK 完成流式对话和结构化输出，再看统一网关怎么切换模型。
roles.pm: 它让“换模型、比价格”几乎零成本，是做模型路由和成本控制的基础。
roles.qa: 常见问题：限流、超时、流式中断、输出不符合约定格式。
roles.algo: 它是线上推理服务的调用端，评测脚本通常也通过它调用模型。

en.what: Official and universal client libraries for hosted models: auth, streaming, retries and structured output in a few lines, for GPT, Claude, Gemini or local models alike.
en.before: Raw HTTP calls and hand-parsed streams, with a different format for every provider.

roles.dev: Get streaming chat and structured output working with one SDK, then see how a gateway switches models.
roles.pm: It makes switching models and comparing prices nearly free — the basis for routing and cost control.
roles.qa: Typical issues: rate limits, timeouts, broken streams and output that violates the expected format.
roles.algo: The client side of production inference; evaluation scripts usually call models through it.

zh.what: 调用大模型服务的官方与通用客户端库：统一处理鉴权、流式输出、重试和结构化输出，让应用用几行代码接上 GPT、Claude、Gemini 或本地模型。
zh.before: 直接拼 HTTP 请求、自己解析流式数据，每家模型的接口格式都不一样。

roles.dev: 先用一个 SDK 完成流式对话和结构化输出，再看统一网关怎么切换模型。
roles.pm: 它让“换模型、比价格”几乎零成本，是做模型路由和成本控制的基础。
roles.qa: 常见问题：限流、超时、流式中断、输出不符合约定格式。
roles.algo: 它是线上推理服务的调用端，评测脚本通常也通过它调用模型。

en.what: Official and universal client libraries for hosted models: auth, streaming, retries and structured output in a few lines, for GPT, Claude, Gemini or local models alike.
en.before: Raw HTTP calls and hand-parsed streams, with a different format for every provider.

roles.dev: Get streaming chat and structured output working with one SDK, then see how a gateway switches models.
roles.pm: It makes switching models and comparing prices nearly free — the basis for routing and cost control.
roles.qa: Typical issues: rate limits, timeouts, broken streams and output that violates the expected format.
roles.algo: The client side of production inference; evaluation scripts usually call models through it.

zh: 第 3 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 4.0，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 9。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
白虎扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 37% · 青龙 9% · 朱雀 16% · 白虎 39%。
大小第 2 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 10。
en: Ring 3: its core members average dependency level 4.0, #9 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
White Tiger sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 37% · Dragon 9% · Bird 16% · Tiger 39%.
Size tier 2: #10 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 构建网页界面的组件框架与样式体系（React、Next.js、Vue 等），绝大多数 AI 对话产品的前端都建在这里。
zh.before: 直接操作页面元素，界面一复杂就难以维护。

roles.dev: 用一个组件框架做出带消息列表和输入框的聊天界面。
roles.pm: 它决定了界面迭代速度，也决定了能复用多少现成组件。
roles.qa: 关注不同浏览器、屏幕尺寸下的显示和流式渲染卡顿。
roles.algo: 与模型无直接关系，但模型输出最终在这里呈现给用户。

en.what: Component frameworks and styling systems (React, Next.js, Vue) for building web interfaces; most AI chat products are built on them.
en.before: Manipulating page elements directly, which collapses as the UI grows.

roles.dev: Build a chat screen with a message list and an input box in one component framework.
roles.pm: It sets UI iteration speed and how much off-the-shelf UI can be reused.
roles.qa: Check rendering across browsers and screen sizes, and jank during streaming.
roles.algo: Not model-related, but it is where model output finally reaches users.

zh.what: 用纯 Python 几行代码就能做出可交互网页的框架，是 AI 模型演示、内部工具和原型的首选界面层。
zh.before: 演示一个模型要单独写前端，或者只能在命令行里给人看。

roles.dev: 把一个模型调用包成一个带输入框和输出区的页面。
roles.pm: 做原型和用户访谈时，它能让想法在一天内变成可点的东西。
roles.qa: 关注并发访问、长任务超时和文件上传边界。
roles.algo: 最常见的模型演示方式，Hugging Face Spaces 大量使用它。

en.what: Frameworks that turn a few lines of pure Python into an interactive web page — the default UI layer for model demos, internal tools and prototypes.
en.before: Demoing a model meant writing a separate frontend or showing a terminal.

roles.dev: Wrap a model call in a page with an input box and an output area.
roles.pm: For prototypes and user interviews, an idea becomes clickable in a day.
roles.qa: Watch concurrency, long-task timeouts and file-upload limits.
roles.algo: The most common way to demo a model; Hugging Face Spaces relies on it heavily.

zh.what: 把模型输出的 Markdown、代码、公式和图表正确渲染出来，并做安全过滤，是对话界面“看起来专业”的关键。
zh.before: 只能显示纯文本，代码和公式挤成一团，还容易被注入脚本。

roles.dev: 让聊天界面正确显示代码高亮、表格和数学公式。
roles.pm: 回答的可读性直接影响用户对 AI 质量的感知。
roles.qa: 重点测流式渲染中途断开、超长代码块和 XSS 注入。
roles.algo: 了解它能明白为什么要让模型输出规范的 Markdown。

en.what: Renders model output — Markdown, code, maths and diagrams — correctly and safely; key to a chat UI that looks professional.
en.before: Plain text only, with code and formulas crammed together and script injection a risk.

roles.dev: Make a chat UI show syntax-highlighted code, tables and maths correctly.
roles.pm: Readability of answers shapes how users judge AI quality.
roles.qa: Test streams cut off mid-render, huge code blocks and XSS injection.
roles.algo: Explains why models are asked to emit well-formed Markdown.

zh.what: 命令行参数解析、彩色输出、进度条和交互提示，是 AI 编码助手、训练脚本和各类开发工具的“外壳”。
zh.before: 手工解析参数，输出全是黑白文字，长任务看不到进度。

roles.dev: 给自己的脚本加上子命令、进度条和彩色日志。
roles.pm: 终端型 AI 工具（如编码助手）的体验很大程度取决于它。
roles.qa: 关注参数组合、异常退出码和非交互环境下的行为。
roles.algo: 训练和评测脚本的参数管理与进度显示都靠它。

en.what: Argument parsing, coloured output, progress bars and prompts — the shell of AI coding assistants, training scripts and dev tools.
en.before: Hand-parsed arguments, monochrome output and no progress on long jobs.

roles.dev: Add sub-commands, a progress bar and coloured logs to your own script.
roles.pm: The experience of terminal AI tools such as coding assistants depends heavily on it.
roles.qa: Check argument combinations, exit codes and behaviour in non-interactive environments.
roles.algo: Training and evaluation scripts use it for arguments and progress.

zh.what: 用户真正看到和操作的部分：网页前端框架、几行 Python 就能出页面的演示界面、把 Markdown 与代码渲染漂亮的组件，以及命令行工具的外壳。
zh.before: 演示一个模型要单独写前端，模型输出只能显示成纯文本，命令行工具全是黑白文字。

roles.dev: 先分清你的项目是网页前端、Python 演示界面还是命令行工具，再看对应分区里的代表包。
roles.pm: 它决定产品“看起来是否专业”：流式输出、代码高亮、公式和图表渲染都在这里。
roles.qa: 重点看流式输出中断、Markdown 渲染注入脚本、长内容卡顿和不同浏览器的差异。
roles.algo: 做模型演示时最常用的是“演示界面”分区（Gradio、Streamlit），其余多由前端同事负责。

en.what: The part users actually see and touch: web front-end frameworks, demo UIs that turn a few lines of Python into a page, components that render Markdown and code nicely, and the shell of command-line tools.
en.before: Demoing a model meant writing a separate front end, model output showed as plain text, and CLI tools printed monochrome walls of text.

roles.dev: First work out whether your project is a web front end, a Python demo UI or a CLI, then look at that region's key packages.
roles.pm: It decides whether the product looks professional: streaming output, code highlighting, maths and chart rendering all live here.
roles.qa: Watch for interrupted streams, script injection via Markdown, sluggish long content and cross-browser differences.
roles.algo: For model demos the Demo UI region (Gradio, Streamlit) matters most; the rest is usually front-end colleagues' territory.

zh: 第 1 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 2.7，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 4。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
白虎扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 30% · 青龙 10% · 朱雀 18% · 白虎 42%。
大小第 5 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 1。
en: Ring 1: its core members average dependency level 2.7, #4 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
White Tiger sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 30% · Dragon 10% · Bird 18% · Tiger 42%.
Size tier 5: #1 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 定义神经网络、自动求导、在 GPU 上训练和运行模型的核心框架（PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX）。几乎所有模型都在这里诞生。
zh.before: 研究者手写梯度公式和 GPU 代码，一个新模型要花数月实现。

roles.dev: 用框架训练一个最小的分类模型，理解张量、前向和反向传播。
roles.pm: 框架选择决定了能用哪些开源模型、招什么样的人。
roles.qa: 数值不稳定、显存溢出和版本不兼容是高发问题。
roles.algo: 你的主战场：训练、微调和导出模型都从这里开始。

en.what: Core frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) for defining neural networks, automatic differentiation and running models on GPUs; almost every model is born here.
en.before: Researchers derived gradients and wrote GPU code by hand; a new model took months.

roles.dev: Train a tiny classifier to understand tensors and forward/backward passes.
roles.pm: The framework decides which open models you can use and whom you hire.
roles.qa: Numerical instability, out-of-memory errors and version mismatches are common.
roles.algo: Your home turf: training, fine-tuning and exporting all start here.

zh.what: 让大模型训练和推理更快、更省显存的底层技术：分布式并行、低比特量化、高效注意力算子和 GPU 内核编译。
zh.before: 模型一大就塞不进单张显卡，只能等更贵的硬件。

roles.dev: 试一次 8 比特或 4 比特加载，对比显存占用。
roles.pm: 它直接决定训练与推理的硬件成本。
roles.qa: 加速后精度下降、不同显卡结果不一致需要回归测试。
roles.algo: 理解注意力优化和并行策略，是训练大模型的必修课。

en.what: Low-level techniques that make large-model training and inference faster and lighter: distributed parallelism, low-bit quantisation, efficient attention kernels and GPU kernel compilers.
en.before: A model too big for one GPU simply waited for pricier hardware.

roles.dev: Try loading a model in 8-bit or 4-bit and compare memory use.
roles.pm: It directly sets hardware cost for training and inference.
roles.qa: Accuracy loss after acceleration and GPU-dependent results need regression tests.
roles.algo: Attention optimisation and parallelism strategies are required knowledge for training large models.

zh.what: 神经网络在这里被定义、求导并在 GPU 上训练（PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX）；分布式并行、低比特量化和高效算子让大模型训得动、跑得快。
zh.before: 研究者手写梯度和 GPU 代码，一个新模型要实现数月；模型一大就塞不进单张显卡。

roles.dev: 先学会用 PyTorch 加载模型、放到 GPU 上跑一次前向计算，再了解量化和混合精度这些省显存的开关。
roles.pm: 训练和推理成本主要由这里决定：显卡数量、显存占用和速度。
roles.qa: 关注不同硬件、驱动和库版本组合下结果是否一致，以及显存溢出。
roles.algo: 你的主战场：张量、自动求导、并行策略和算子性能。

en.what: Neural networks are defined, differentiated and trained on GPUs here (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX); distributed parallelism, low-bit quantisation and fast kernels make large models trainable and fast.
en.before: Researchers hand-wrote gradients and GPU code, a new model took months to implement, and anything large would not fit on one GPU.

roles.dev: Learn to load a model with PyTorch and run one forward pass on a GPU, then learn the memory-saving switches such as quantisation and mixed precision.
roles.pm: Most training and inference cost is decided here: number of GPUs, memory use and speed.
roles.qa: Check results stay consistent across hardware, driver and library-version combinations, and watch for out-of-memory errors.
roles.algo: Your home ground: tensors, autograd, parallelism strategies and kernel performance.

zh: 第 2 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 3.5，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 7。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
青龙扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 6% · 青龙 55% · 朱雀 30% · 白虎 9%。
大小第 3 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 6。
en: Ring 2: its core members average dependency level 3.5, #7 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Azure Dragon sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 6% · Dragon 55% · Bird 30% · Tiger 9%.
Size tier 3: #6 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 下载、加载和微调预训练模型的生态（以 Hugging Face 为代表）：一行代码拿到别人训练好的模型、分词器和数据集。
zh.before: 每个模型各有一套下载方式和加载代码，复现论文要先折腾半天环境。

roles.dev: 用几行代码加载一个开源模型并完成一次推理。
roles.pm: 它让“用开源模型替代 API”成为可选项，影响成本与数据合规。
roles.qa: 模型版本漂移、权重文件损坏和分词不一致是常见坑。
roles.algo: 微调（含 LoRA）与对齐训练的标准工具都在这里。

en.what: The ecosystem (led by Hugging Face) for downloading, loading and fine-tuning pretrained models: one line gets someone else's model, tokenizer and dataset.
en.before: Every model had its own download scheme and loader; reproducing a paper started with hours of setup.

roles.dev: Load an open model and run one inference in a few lines.
roles.pm: It makes open models a real alternative to APIs, affecting cost and data compliance.
roles.qa: Model version drift, corrupted weights and tokenizer mismatches are common traps.
roles.algo: Standard tools for fine-tuning (incl. LoRA) and alignment live here.

zh.what: 交互式 Notebook 和实验跟踪工具：边写代码边看结果，并记录每次训练的参数、指标和产物。
zh.before: 实验结果散落在终端输出和 Excel 里，几周后就说不清哪次效果最好。

roles.dev: 在 Notebook 里分步跑通一个数据分析或模型调用。
roles.pm: 它让算法团队的实验可追溯，是评审模型迭代的依据。
roles.qa: 实验可复现性（随机种子、数据版本）是验收重点。
roles.algo: 记录超参数和指标曲线，是你每天都会用的工具。

en.what: Interactive notebooks and experiment trackers: see results as you code, and record each run's parameters, metrics and artefacts.
en.before: Results scattered across terminal output and spreadsheets; weeks later nobody knew which run was best.

roles.dev: Work through a data analysis or model call step by step in a notebook.
roles.pm: It makes experiments traceable, the evidence base for reviewing model iterations.
roles.qa: Reproducibility (seeds, data versions) is the key acceptance criterion.
roles.algo: Logging hyper-parameters and metric curves — a daily tool.

zh.what: 拿到和管理模型的一层：以 Hugging Face 为代表的模型仓库，一行代码下载别人训练好的模型、分词器和数据集；Notebook 与实验跟踪工具记录每次尝试的参数和效果。
zh.before: 每个模型各有一套下载和加载方式，实验结果散落在终端输出和表格里，几周后说不清哪次最好。

roles.dev: 先用 transformers 加载一个现成模型跑通推理，再用实验跟踪工具记录一次微调。
roles.pm: 它决定能多快试用一个新开源模型，以及团队能否复现“上次效果最好的那版”。
roles.qa: 关注模型版本、分词器版本和数据集版本是否对得上，实验记录能否复现。
roles.algo: 微调、评测与对比实验的日常工作台。

en.what: The layer for getting and managing models: model hubs led by Hugging Face hand you trained models, tokenizers and datasets in one line, and notebooks plus experiment trackers record the settings and results of every attempt.
en.before: Every model had its own download and loading code, and results lay scattered across terminal output and spreadsheets, so weeks later no one knew which run was best.

roles.dev: Load a ready-made model with transformers and run inference, then log one fine-tuning run with an experiment tracker.
roles.pm: It decides how fast you can try a new open model and whether the team can reproduce “the best version last time”.
roles.qa: Check that model, tokenizer and dataset versions match, and that experiment records can be reproduced.
roles.algo: Your daily workbench for fine-tuning, evaluation and comparison runs.

zh: 第 4 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 4.8，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 12。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
青龙扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 10% · 青龙 46% · 朱雀 31% · 白虎 13%。
大小第 3 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 5。
en: Ring 4: its core members average dependency level 4.8, #12 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Azure Dragon sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 10% · Dragon 46% · Bird 31% · Tiger 13%.
Size tier 3: #5 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 读取、处理和理解图像与视频：图像编解码、裁剪增强、目标检测和视觉模型。
zh.before: 每种图片格式要单独处理，检测模型需要从零训练。

roles.dev: 读一张图、做缩放裁剪，再跑一个现成的检测模型。
roles.pm: OCR、质检、视觉问答等功能的可行性取决于这里的成熟度。
roles.qa: 注意色彩空间、图片方向和超大尺寸输入。
roles.algo: 视觉语言模型的数据预处理与评测都离不开它。

en.what: Reading, processing and understanding images and video: codecs, cropping and augmentation, object detection and vision models.
en.before: Each image format needed its own handling, and detectors were trained from scratch.

roles.dev: Load an image, resize and crop it, then run an off-the-shelf detector.
roles.pm: Feasibility of OCR, inspection and visual Q&A depends on how mature this layer is.
roles.qa: Watch colour spaces, image orientation and oversized inputs.
roles.algo: Data preprocessing and evaluation for vision-language models depend on it.

zh.what: 读写音频、提取声学特征、语音识别与合成，是语音助手和实时语音交互的底座。
zh.before: 语音识别依赖昂贵的商业引擎，音频格式转换要靠命令行工具拼凑。

roles.dev: 把一段录音转成文字，再把文字合成语音。
roles.pm: 实时语音体验的延迟和成本主要由这里决定。
roles.qa: 测噪声、口音、长音频切分和采样率不一致。
roles.algo: 语音模型训练的数据处理与特征提取在这里。

en.what: Audio I/O, acoustic features, speech recognition and synthesis — the base of voice assistants and real-time voice interaction.
en.before: Speech recognition meant expensive commercial engines, and format conversion meant stitching CLI tools.

roles.dev: Transcribe a recording, then synthesise speech from text.
roles.pm: Latency and cost of real-time voice are largely decided here.
roles.qa: Test noise, accents, long-audio segmentation and mismatched sample rates.
roles.algo: Data processing and feature extraction for speech models happen here.

zh.what: 让 AI 看和听：图像与视频的读取、处理和检测模型，音频读写、语音识别与合成。
zh.before: 每种图片和音频格式要单独处理，检测和语音识别依赖从零训练的模型或昂贵的商业引擎。

roles.dev: 先学会读写图片和音频文件、做格式转换，再接一个现成的识别模型。
roles.pm: 它决定产品能否“看图说话”、听懂语音、开口回答，以及实时交互的延迟。
roles.qa: 关注不同格式、分辨率、采样率和噪声环境下的表现。
roles.algo: 多模态模型的数据预处理和特征提取都在这里。

en.what: Lets AI see and hear: reading, processing and detection models for images and video; audio I/O, speech recognition and synthesis.
en.before: Every image and audio format needed its own handling, and detection or speech recognition meant training from scratch or paying for commercial engines.

roles.dev: Learn to read, write and convert image and audio files, then plug in a ready-made recognition model.
roles.pm: It decides whether the product can describe images, understand speech and talk back — and how laggy real-time interaction feels.
roles.qa: Test across formats, resolutions, sample rates and noisy conditions.
roles.algo: Data preprocessing and feature extraction for multimodal models live here.

zh: 第 2 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 3.2，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 6。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
青龙扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 9% · 青龙 30% · 朱雀 32% · 白虎 29%。
大小第 2 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 11。
en: Ring 2: its core members average dependency level 3.2, #6 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Azure Dragon sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 9% · Dragon 30% · Bird 32% · Tiger 29%.
Size tier 2: #11 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 把训练好的模型高效地跑起来：批处理调度、KV 缓存管理、量化和跨硬件部署，决定每秒能服务多少请求。
zh.before: 用训练框架直接推理，显存浪费严重，并发一高就排队。

roles.dev: 在本地用一个推理引擎起一个兼容 OpenAI 接口的模型服务。
roles.pm: 它决定自建模型服务的单位成本和响应速度。
roles.qa: 压测吞吐与首字延迟，关注长上下文和高并发下的稳定性。
roles.algo: 模型上线前的最后一站：量化、编译和服务化都在这里。

en.what: Runs trained models efficiently: batching, KV-cache management, quantisation and cross-hardware deployment decide how many requests per second you can serve.
en.before: Inference ran in training frameworks, wasting memory and queuing under load.

roles.dev: Start a local OpenAI-compatible model server with an inference engine.
roles.pm: It sets unit cost and response speed for self-hosted models.
roles.qa: Load-test throughput and time-to-first-token; watch stability with long contexts and high concurrency.
roles.algo: The last stop before production: quantisation, compilation and serving.

zh.what: 把计算任务拆分到多台机器或多个进程上执行，并按依赖关系调度数据处理和训练流水线。
zh.before: 单机脚本跑不动大数据，只能手工切分任务、轮流执行。

roles.dev: 用一个分布式框架把单机循环改成并行任务。
roles.pm: 大规模数据处理和批量推理的时效与成本取决于它。
roles.qa: 测任务失败重试、部分节点宕机和结果一致性。
roles.algo: 大规模数据预处理、分布式训练和超参搜索常用它。

en.what: Spreads computation across machines or processes and schedules data and training pipelines by dependency.
en.before: Single-machine scripts choked on big data; tasks were split and run by hand.

roles.dev: Turn a single-machine loop into parallel tasks with a distributed framework.
roles.pm: Turnaround and cost of large data jobs and batch inference depend on it.
roles.qa: Test task retries, node failures and result consistency.
roles.algo: Common for large-scale preprocessing, distributed training and hyper-parameter search.

zh.what: 把训练好的模型高效地跑起来：推理引擎负责批处理调度、KV 缓存和量化部署；分布式计算框架把大批任务拆到多台机器上执行。
zh.before: 直接用训练框架推理，显存浪费、并发一高就排队；大数据任务只能手工切分、轮流执行。

roles.dev: 先用一个推理引擎在本地启动模型服务，看它暴露的接口和吞吐指标。
roles.pm: 它决定每次回答的成本和速度，以及同时能服务多少用户。
roles.qa: 关注高并发下的延迟、长上下文时的显存溢出和不同量化精度下的质量差异。
roles.algo: 推理优化（批处理、缓存、量化、投机解码）和大规模数据处理流水线。

en.what: Runs trained models efficiently: inference engines handle batching, KV caching and quantised deployment, while distributed compute frameworks spread large batches of work across many machines.
en.before: Serving with a training framework wasted memory and queued under load, and big data jobs were split by hand and run in turn.

roles.dev: Start a model server locally with an inference engine and look at the API and throughput numbers it exposes.
roles.pm: It decides the cost and speed of every answer, and how many users you can serve at once.
roles.qa: Watch latency under high concurrency, memory overflows on long contexts, and quality differences between quantisation levels.
roles.algo: Inference optimisation (batching, caching, quantisation, speculative decoding) and large-scale data pipelines.

zh: 第 3 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 4.0，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 10。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
朱雀扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 26% · 青龙 20% · 朱雀 36% · 白虎 18%。
大小第 1 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 12。
en: Ring 3: its core members average dependency level 4.0, #10 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Vermilion Bird sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 26% · Dragon 20% · Bird 36% · Tiger 18%.
Size tier 1: #12 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 把程序变成可通过网络调用的服务接口（API），处理路由、请求校验、流式响应和并发。
zh.before: 用底层套接字或重量级应用服务器，写一个接口要大量样板代码。

roles.dev: 用一个框架写出带流式输出的 /chat 接口。
roles.pm: 它是 AI 能力对外开放、接入业务系统的出口。
roles.qa: 测接口契约、鉴权、超时和流式连接中断。
roles.algo: 把模型包成服务时最常用的一层。

en.what: Turns programs into network APIs: routing, request validation, streaming responses and concurrency.
en.before: Raw sockets or heavyweight app servers, with piles of boilerplate per endpoint.

roles.dev: Write a streaming /chat endpoint in one framework.
roles.pm: It is the exit through which AI capabilities reach business systems.
roles.qa: Test API contracts, auth, timeouts and dropped streaming connections.
roles.algo: The most common layer for wrapping a model as a service.

zh.what: 发起 HTTP 请求、处理连接池、异步并发和 WebSocket，是所有“调用远程服务”的程序共同的底座。
zh.before: 直接用语言自带的底层库，重试、超时、编码都要自己处理。

roles.dev: 用异步客户端并发请求多个接口并设置超时与重试。
roles.pm: 外部 API 调用的稳定性和延迟，很多时候卡在这一层。
roles.qa: 代理、证书、超时和连接复用问题都出在这里。
roles.algo: 下载数据集、调用远程模型时都在用它。

en.what: HTTP requests, connection pools, async concurrency and WebSockets — the shared base of every program that calls remote services.
en.before: Low-level standard libraries, with retries, timeouts and encodings handled by hand.

roles.dev: Fire concurrent requests with an async client, with timeouts and retries.
roles.pm: Stability and latency of external API calls often bottleneck here.
roles.qa: Proxy, certificate, timeout and connection-reuse issues live here.
roles.algo: Used whenever datasets are downloaded or remote models called.

zh.what: 程序之间通过网络对话的一层：Web 服务框架把程序变成可调用的接口，网络库负责发请求、连接池、异步并发和 WebSocket。
zh.before: 用底层套接字写接口，重试、超时、编码都要自己处理，写一个接口要大量样板代码。

roles.dev: 先用 FastAPI 写一个返回流式输出的接口，再用 httpx 从另一端调用它。
roles.pm: 接口是否稳定、能否流式返回、超时怎么处理，用户都直接感受得到。
roles.qa: 重点测超时、重试、断线重连和请求格式错误时的返回。
roles.algo: 把模型包装成服务、调用远程模型接口时都会用到。

en.what: The layer where programs talk over the network: web frameworks turn code into callable APIs, and networking libraries handle requests, connection pools, async concurrency and WebSockets.
en.before: APIs were written on raw sockets, with retries, timeouts and encoding all done by hand and piles of boilerplate per endpoint.

roles.dev: Write a streaming endpoint with FastAPI, then call it from the other side with httpx.
roles.pm: Users feel directly whether the API is stable, streams its output and handles timeouts gracefully.
roles.qa: Focus on timeouts, retries, reconnects and responses to malformed requests.
roles.algo: You use it whenever you wrap a model as a service or call a remote model API.

zh: 第 1 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 2.0，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 2。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
朱雀扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 21% · 青龙 15% · 朱雀 32% · 白虎 32%。
大小第 5 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 2。
en: Ring 1: its core members average dependency level 2.0, #2 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Vermilion Bird sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 21% · Dragon 15% · Bird 32% · Tiger 32%.
Size tier 5: #2 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 调用云厂商的存储、计算和身份服务，以及用容器打包和编排程序，是把 AI 系统真正部署上线的通道。
zh.before: 手工登录服务器部署，环境不一致导致“我这里能跑”。

roles.dev: 把一个服务打包成容器镜像，并读写一次对象存储。
roles.pm: 私有化、SaaS 还是混合部署，落地时都要经过这一层。
roles.qa: 关注权限配置、地域差异和资源配额。
roles.algo: 训练数据和模型权重通常存放在对象存储里。

en.what: Cloud storage, compute and identity services, plus containers for packaging and orchestration — the path to actually shipping AI systems.
en.before: Manual server logins and “works on my machine” environments.

roles.dev: Package a service as a container image and read/write object storage once.
roles.pm: Private, SaaS or hybrid deployment all pass through this layer.
roles.qa: Watch permission settings, regional differences and quotas.
roles.algo: Training data and model weights usually live in object storage.

zh.what: 记录、追踪和评测 AI 系统在线上的行为：调用链路、成本、延迟，以及回答质量的自动评分。
zh.before: 出了问题只能翻日志猜原因，模型改版后质量变好还是变差说不清。

roles.dev: 给一次模型调用接上链路追踪，看到每一步的耗时和输入输出。
roles.pm: 没有它就无法建立 AI 产品的质量指标和回归门禁。
roles.qa: 你的核心工具：评测集、模型评审和回归测试都在这里。
roles.algo: 离线评测和线上监控把模型效果连成闭环。

en.what: Logging, tracing and evaluating AI systems in production: call chains, cost, latency and automatic scoring of answer quality.
en.before: Problems meant guessing from logs, and nobody could say whether a model change helped or hurt.

roles.dev: Add tracing to one model call to see each step's latency and I/O.
roles.pm: Without it there are no quality metrics or regression gates for an AI product.
roles.qa: Your core toolkit: eval sets, LLM-as-judge and regression tests live here.
roles.algo: Offline evaluation plus online monitoring closes the loop on model quality.

zh.what: 把 AI 系统部署上线并看清它在做什么：调用云服务、用容器打包部署，记录调用链路、成本和延迟，并自动评测回答质量。
zh.before: 手工登录服务器部署，环境不一致；出了问题只能翻日志猜，模型改版后质量变好还是变差说不清。

roles.dev: 先把应用装进容器跑起来，再接一个追踪工具，看一次请求经过了哪些模型调用。
roles.pm: 成本、延迟和回答质量的数字都从这里来，是做取舍的依据。
roles.qa: 评测集、自动打分和线上回归监控是你的主要工具。
roles.algo: 离线评测和线上指标的桥梁，模型改版前后用它对比。

en.what: Gets AI systems into production and shows what they are doing: cloud services and containers for deployment, plus tracing of call chains, cost and latency, and automatic grading of answer quality.
en.before: Deployments meant logging into servers by hand with mismatched environments; when something broke you guessed from logs, and no one could say whether a model update made answers better or worse.

roles.dev: Put the app in a container and run it, then add a tracing tool to see which model calls one request makes.
roles.pm: The cost, latency and quality numbers you make trade-offs with come from here.
roles.qa: Eval sets, automatic grading and production regression monitoring are your main tools.
roles.algo: The bridge between offline evaluation and live metrics; use it to compare before and after a model change.

zh.what: 把文本、图片变成向量，并在海量向量中快速找出最相似的那些，是 RAG（检索增强生成）的核心。
zh.before: 只能按关键词搜索，同义词、换个说法就找不到。

roles.dev: 把一组文档向量化存进向量库，再用一句话检索出最相关的段落。
roles.pm: 它决定知识库问答的召回质量和存储成本。
roles.qa: 测召回率、相似度阈值和数据更新后的索引一致性。
roles.algo: 嵌入模型选型与检索评测指标是你的重点。

en.what: Turns text and images into vectors and finds the most similar ones among millions — the heart of RAG.
en.before: Keyword search only; synonyms and paraphrases were missed.

roles.dev: Embed a set of documents into a vector store, then retrieve the best passages for a query.
roles.pm: It sets recall quality and storage cost for knowledge-base Q&A.
roles.qa: Test recall, similarity thresholds and index consistency after updates.
roles.algo: Embedding model choice and retrieval metrics are your focus.

zh.what: 把文本、图片变成向量，并在海量向量中快速找出最相似的那些，是 RAG（检索增强生成）的核心。
zh.before: 只能按关键词搜索，同义词、换个说法就找不到。

roles.algo: 嵌入模型选型与检索评测指标是你的重点。

zh: 第 3 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 3.5，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 8。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
玄武扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 42% · 青龙 8% · 朱雀 8% · 白虎 42%。
大小第 1 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 13。
en: Ring 3: its core members average dependency level 3.5, #8 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Black Tortoise sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 42% · Dragon 8% · Bird 8% · Tiger 42%.
Size tier 1: #13 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 关系型数据库、缓存、图数据库和数据库访问层，存放用户、会话、业务数据与智能体的长期记忆。
zh.before: 数据存在文件里，并发读写和查询都很痛苦。

roles.dev: 用一个数据库访问库完成建表、写入和查询。
roles.pm: 会话记录、用户数据、权限都落在这里，是合规和数据治理的重点。
roles.qa: 事务、并发写入、迁移脚本和备份恢复是测试重点。
roles.algo: 特征存储和评测结果也常放在数据库里。

en.what: Relational databases, caches, graph databases and access layers that store users, sessions, business data and agents' long-term memory.
en.before: Data lived in files; concurrent writes and queries were painful.

roles.dev: Create a table, insert and query with a database library.
roles.pm: Sessions, user data and permissions land here — the focus of compliance and governance.
roles.qa: Transactions, concurrent writes, migrations and backup/restore are test priorities.
roles.algo: Feature stores and evaluation results often live in databases too.

zh.what: 定义数据结构、校验输入输出、在程序之间序列化传输数据（Pydantic、Zod、Protobuf 等），也是让模型输出可靠 JSON 的关键。
zh.before: 到处手写 if 判断字段是否存在，接口一变就悄悄出错。

roles.dev: 用一个模式库定义请求结构，并让模型按这个结构输出。
roles.pm: 结构化输出让 AI 结果能直接进入业务流程，而不是停留在聊天框里。
roles.qa: 字段缺失、类型错误和版本兼容是主要测试点。
roles.algo: 函数调用和结构化输出的约束都基于它定义的模式。

en.what: Defining data structures, validating input/output and serialising data between programs (Pydantic, Zod, Protobuf) — also the key to reliable JSON from models.
en.before: Hand-written field checks everywhere, failing silently when an interface changed.

roles.dev: Define a request schema and make a model answer in exactly that shape.
roles.pm: Structured output lets AI results flow straight into business processes instead of staying in a chat box.
roles.qa: Missing fields, wrong types and version compatibility are the main test points.
roles.algo: Function-calling and structured-output constraints are defined with these schemas.

zh.what: 数据放在哪、长什么样：数据库、缓存和数据库访问层存放业务数据与智能体的长期记忆；数据校验与序列化库（Pydantic、Zod、Protobuf）规定数据结构，也是让模型输出可靠 JSON 的关键。
zh.before: 数据存在文件里，并发读写和查询都很痛苦；到处手写字段判断，接口一变就悄悄出错。

roles.dev: 先学会用 Pydantic 定义一个数据结构并校验模型输出，再看项目用的是哪种数据库。
roles.pm: 它决定数据能否可靠保存、能否被查询，以及模型输出能否稳定地变成结构化结果。
roles.qa: 关注字段缺失、类型不符、并发写入和数据迁移。
roles.algo: 结构化输出和工具调用参数的校验都靠这里。

en.what: Where data lives and what shape it takes: databases, caches and data-access layers store business data and agents' long-term memory, while validation and serialisation libraries (Pydantic, Zod, Protobuf) define data structures and are key to getting reliable JSON out of models.
en.before: Data sat in files, making concurrent reads, writes and queries painful, and hand-written field checks everywhere broke silently whenever an interface changed.

roles.dev: Define a data structure with Pydantic and validate a model's output with it, then find out which database your project uses.
roles.pm: It decides whether data is stored reliably and queryable, and whether model output reliably becomes structured results.
roles.qa: Watch for missing fields, wrong types, concurrent writes and data migrations.
roles.algo: Validation of structured output and tool-call arguments depends on it.

zh: 第 1 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 1.8，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 1。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
玄武扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 26% · 青龙 18% · 朱雀 25% · 白虎 30%。
大小第 4 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 3。
en: Ring 1: its core members average dependency level 1.8, #1 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Black Tortoise sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 26% · Dragon 18% · Bird 25% · Tiger 30%.
Size tier 4: #3 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 把 PDF、Word、网页、表格等各种格式转成模型能读的干净文本和结构，是知识库建设的第一步。
zh.before: 复制粘贴或手写解析脚本，表格和版面信息全部丢失。

roles.dev: 把一份 PDF 转成带标题层级的 Markdown。
roles.pm: 文档解析质量往往是企业知识库项目成败的隐形瓶颈。
roles.qa: 扫描件、复杂表格、页眉页脚和多栏排版最容易出错。
roles.algo: 清洗后的文档质量直接影响检索和微调数据的质量。

en.what: Turns PDFs, Word files, web pages and spreadsheets into clean text and structure a model can read — step one of any knowledge base.
en.before: Copy-paste or hand-written parsers that lost tables and layout.

roles.dev: Convert a PDF into Markdown with its heading hierarchy.
roles.pm: Parsing quality is often the hidden bottleneck of enterprise knowledge-base projects.
roles.qa: Scans, complex tables, headers/footers and multi-column layouts break most often.
roles.algo: Cleaned document quality directly shapes retrieval and fine-tuning data quality.

zh.what: 分词、统计 Token、语言识别和传统自然语言处理：理解“模型按 Token 计费、按 Token 计长度”的基础。
zh.before: 按字数估算长度，中文分词各家规则不一。

roles.dev: 用分词器数一段中文和一段英文各有多少 Token。
roles.pm: Token 数直接等于成本和上下文容量，是定价和设计的基本单位。
roles.qa: 注意多语言、表情符号和特殊字符导致的长度偏差。
roles.algo: 分词器设计影响模型效果和多语言能力。

en.what: Tokenisation, token counting, language detection and classic NLP — the basis for understanding why models bill and measure length in tokens.
en.before: Length estimated by characters, and every Chinese segmenter had its own rules.

roles.dev: Count the tokens in a Chinese and an English passage with a tokenizer.
roles.pm: Token counts equal cost and context capacity — the basic unit for pricing and design.
roles.qa: Watch length errors from multilingual text, emoji and special characters.
roles.algo: Tokenizer design affects model quality and multilingual ability.

zh.what: 抓取网页、驱动真实浏览器、把页面转成干净文本，是智能体“上网”和 RAG 采集资料的入口。
zh.before: 手写正则抓 HTML，遇到动态页面和登录就束手无策。

roles.dev: 用无头浏览器打开一个动态页面并提取正文。
roles.pm: 它决定了“让 AI 读网页、操作网页”的可行性和合规边界。
roles.qa: 网页改版、反爬、超时和编码问题是主要故障源。
roles.algo: 预训练语料和检索语料的采集环节都依赖它。

en.what: Scraping pages, driving real browsers and turning pages into clean text — how agents get online and how RAG systems collect material.
en.before: Hand-written regexes over HTML, helpless against dynamic pages and logins.

roles.dev: Open a dynamic page with a headless browser and extract the main text.
roles.pm: It sets what is feasible — and compliant — when AI reads or operates websites.
roles.qa: Site redesigns, anti-bot measures, timeouts and encodings are the main failure sources.
roles.algo: Both pre-training corpora and retrieval corpora are collected with it.

zh.what: 把资料变成模型能读的文本：抓取网页与驱动浏览器，把 PDF、Word、表格转成干净的结构化文本，再做分词和 Token 统计。
zh.before: 复制粘贴或写正则抓 HTML，表格和版面信息全部丢失，按字数估算长度。

roles.dev: 先把一份 PDF 和一个网页转成纯文本，再用分词器数一数它有多少 Token。
roles.pm: 知识库好不好用，很大程度取决于这一步把资料读得干不干净；按 Token 计费也从这里理解。
roles.qa: 关注扫描件、复杂表格、动态网页和多语言文本的解析质量。
roles.algo: RAG 和训练数据清洗的第一道工序。

en.what: Turns source material into text a model can read: crawling pages and driving browsers, converting PDFs, Word files and tables into clean structured text, then tokenising and counting tokens.
en.before: People copy-pasted or regex-scraped HTML, lost every table and layout cue, and estimated length by character count.

roles.dev: Convert one PDF and one web page into plain text, then count its tokens with a tokenizer.
roles.pm: How useful a knowledge base is depends heavily on how cleanly this step reads the material; token-based pricing makes sense from here too.
roles.qa: Check parsing quality on scans, complex tables, dynamic pages and multilingual text.
roles.algo: The first stage of both RAG and training-data cleaning.

zh: 第 2 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 2.8，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 5。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
玄武扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 35% · 青龙 18% · 朱雀 14% · 白虎 34%。
大小第 3 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 7。
en: Ring 2: its core members average dependency level 2.8, #5 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Black Tortoise sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 35% · Dragon 18% · Bird 14% · Tiger 34%.
Size tier 3: #7 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: 多维数组、科学计算和表格数据框（NumPy、Pandas 等），是 Python 数据与 AI 世界的“通用语言”。
zh.before: 用循环逐个处理数字，速度慢、代码长，各库之间数据格式互不相通。

roles.dev: 用数据框读一份 CSV，完成筛选、分组和统计。
roles.pm: 数据分析、指标计算和模型输入准备都从这里开始。
roles.qa: 缺失值、类型转换和浮点精度是常见问题源。
roles.algo: 张量概念从这里起步，所有训练数据都要经过它。

en.what: N-dimensional arrays, scientific computing and dataframes (NumPy, pandas) — the lingua franca of Python data and AI.
en.before: Element-by-element loops: slow, verbose, and every library had its own data format.

roles.dev: Load a CSV into a dataframe and filter, group and aggregate it.
roles.pm: Data analysis, metric computation and model input prep all start here.
roles.qa: Missing values, type casts and floating-point precision cause many bugs.
roles.algo: The idea of tensors starts here; all training data passes through it.

zh.what: 回归、分类、聚类、梯度提升树等经典机器学习算法，至今仍是表格数据预测和风控、推荐的主力。
zh.before: 每个算法都要照论文自己实现，难以对比和复用。

roles.dev: 用几行代码训练一个分类器并输出评估指标。
roles.pm: 很多“AI 需求”用经典模型就能更便宜地解决。
roles.qa: 数据泄漏和训练/线上特征不一致是典型问题。
roles.algo: 特征工程、交叉验证和评估指标的基本功。

en.what: Classic algorithms — regression, classification, clustering, gradient-boosted trees — still the workhorses for tabular prediction, risk and recommendation.
en.before: Each algorithm was implemented from its paper, hard to compare or reuse.

roles.dev: Train a classifier in a few lines and print its metrics.
roles.pm: Many “AI requirements” are solved more cheaply with classic models.
roles.qa: Data leakage and train/serve feature skew are the classic bugs.
roles.algo: Fundamentals: feature engineering, cross-validation and metrics.

zh.what: 绘制图表、仪表盘和三维/地理可视化，把数据和模型结果变成看得懂的画面（本页的星图也站在这里）。
zh.before: 导出到 Excel 手工画图，难以复用和交互。

roles.dev: 把一组指标画成折线图并加上交互提示。
roles.pm: 数据看板和结果展示是向业务方证明价值的方式。
roles.qa: 注意大数据量渲染性能和坐标轴、单位是否正确。
roles.algo: 训练曲线、混淆矩阵和嵌入可视化都靠它。

en.what: Charts, dashboards and 3D/geo visualisation that turn data and model results into readable pictures (this star map stands here too).
en.before: Export to a spreadsheet and draw by hand — hard to reuse or interact with.

roles.dev: Plot a metric as a line chart with interactive tooltips.
roles.pm: Dashboards and result displays are how value is proven to the business.
roles.qa: Check rendering performance with large data and correct axes and units.
roles.algo: Training curves, confusion matrices and embedding plots rely on it.

zh.what: Python 数据世界的通用语言：多维数组与数据框（NumPy、Pandas），回归、分类、聚类等经典机器学习，以及把结果画成图表的可视化库。
zh.before: 用循环逐个处理数字，每个算法照论文自己实现，结果导出到 Excel 手工画图。

roles.dev: 先熟悉 NumPy 数组和 Pandas 数据框的基本操作，几乎所有 AI 代码都从这里读入数据。
roles.pm: 指标分析、A/B 测试和流失预测这类数据工作，主要用的就是这一组工具。
roles.qa: 关注数据类型、缺失值和浮点精度带来的结果差异。
roles.algo: 特征工程、基线模型和结果可视化的日常工具。

en.what: The lingua franca of Python data work: n-dimensional arrays and data frames (NumPy, pandas), classic machine learning such as regression, classification and clustering, and libraries that turn results into charts.
en.before: Numbers were processed in loops, every algorithm was implemented from its paper, and results went to Excel for hand-drawn charts.

roles.dev: Get comfortable with NumPy arrays and pandas data frames first — almost all AI code loads its data through them.
roles.pm: Metric analysis, A/B tests and churn prediction mostly run on this set of tools.
roles.qa: Watch for result differences caused by data types, missing values and floating-point precision.
roles.algo: Everyday tools for feature engineering, baseline models and plotting results.

zh: 第 1 轨：身份明确的成员平均依赖层级 2.2，在 13 颗行星中由内向外排第 3。轨道只表示平均层级，不表示它依赖哪颗行星。
玄武扇区：人工策划；下游卫星使用份额 玄武 26% · 青龙 29% · 朱雀 29% · 白虎 17%。
大小第 4 档：成员承重度之和在可见行星中排第 4。
en: Ring 1: its core members average dependency level 2.2, #3 of 13 planets from the inside out. A ring shows average level only, not which planets it depends on.
Black Tortoise sector: curated; downstream usage share — Tortoise 26% · Dragon 29% · Bird 29% · Tiger 17%.
Size tier 4: #4 among visible planets by summed load-bearing score.

zh.what: Python 世界里被大量项目共用的小工具：类型补丁、版本解析、时间处理、模板、重试等。单个不起眼，合起来是所有上层的“地板”。
zh.before: 每个项目各写一份工具函数，重复且容易出错。

roles.dev: 遇到时查一下用途即可，不必系统学习。
roles.pm: 了解即可：它们说明“开源地基”远不止几个明星项目。
roles.qa: 依赖版本冲突常常就发生在这些小库上。
roles.algo: 了解即可。

en.what: Small utilities shared across the Python world: typing back-ports, version parsing, dates, templating, retries. Unremarkable alone, together they are the floor under everything.
en.before: Every project rewrote the same helpers, with the same bugs.

roles.dev: Look them up when you meet them; no need to study systematically.
roles.pm: Good to know: open-source foundations are far more than a few star projects.
roles.qa: Version conflicts often happen in these small libraries.
roles.algo: Good to know.

zh.what: Node.js 世界里被大量项目共用的小工具：日志开关、路径匹配、版本比较、环境变量、类型声明等。
zh.before: 每个项目各写一份工具函数，重复且容易出错。

roles.dev: 遇到时查一下用途即可，不必系统学习。
roles.pm: 了解即可。
roles.qa: 依赖冲突和供应链安全问题常出在这些小库上。
roles.algo: 了解即可。

en.what: Small utilities shared across Node.js: debug switches, glob matching, version comparison, env vars, type declarations.
en.before: Every project rewrote the same helpers, with the same bugs.

roles.dev: Look them up when you meet them; no need to study systematically.
roles.pm: Good to know.
roles.qa: Dependency conflicts and supply-chain issues often start in these small libraries.
roles.algo: Good to know.

zh.what: 被两个生态里大量项目共用的小工具：类型补丁、版本解析、时间处理、日志开关、路径匹配、环境变量等。单个不起眼，合起来是所有上层的地板，所以画成环绕地心的一圈工具带，而不是一颗行星。
zh.before: 每个项目各写一份工具函数，重复且容易出错。

roles.dev: 不需要系统学习：先认识最常被应用直接使用的那几个，其余遇到再查。
roles.pm: 知道它们存在即可：数量多、单个分量小，但一个出问题会波及很多上层。
